Help: Enables boost

Help: Amount of vertical thrust for boost. 0 is no thrust. 1 is 1G acceleration up. 2 is 2G acceleration.

Help: Vertical tightness for boost. Enables faster acceleration during boost without jumps going too high.

Help: Seconds into boost before boost thrust starts being applied. Meant to provide more consistent jump impulse on tap

Help: Maximum boost duration in seconds.

Help: You can boost if you have rodeo'd within this time. Fixes not being able to boost off a rodeo.

Help: You can boost if you have touched ground within this time. Avoids missing out on boost because you are not on-ground on that exact frame.

Help: Horizontal speed at which drag is applied after drag delay. 0 disables horizontal boost drag.

Help: Delay in seconds between jump and horizontal drag applying.

Name: boostHorizontalDragAmount
Help: Amount of drag applied in velocity units per-second.

Help: Threshold of boost meter below which climb starts automatically (without button press) if you continue to hold down jump near the apex of boost.

Name: boostAutoGlideMeterThreshold

Name: boostAutoJetpackMeterThreshold

Name: boostRepeatedBoostsAreShort
Help: If true then repeated boosts (boosts without full glide meter) are short and immediately transition to jet state

Name: boostRepeatedBoostMeterCost

Help: Enables jetpack

Help: Rate multiplier for how much glide meter the jetpack. 2.0 means jetpack uses meter at twice the rate of glide.

Name: jetpackTightnessSideways

Name: jetpackStrafe
Help: Jetpack strafe acceleration applied according to left stick.

Help: Vertical speed threshold below which jetpack parameters (thrust, tightness, redirect) are blended towards glide values

Name: glideEnabled
Help: Enables glide

Help: Amount of vertical thrust for glide. 0 is no thrust. 1 is 1G acceleration up. 2 is 2G acceleration.

Name: glideThreshold
Help: Threshold velocity z below which glide kicks in instead of jetpack.

Name: glideStrafe
